direction: Inspired by Yan Long action legends with a fiery dragon warrior, side-scrolling combat, flame powers, and boss-focused chapter progression.
selected_concept: Side-scrolling action stage game where a fire dragon warrior clears enemy waves, builds heat energy, transforms into a half-dragon burst state, and defeats chapter bosses.
core_loop_signature: advance through side-scrolling combat arenas chain melee attacks build heat spend flame skills transform into half-dragon overdrive and defeat chapter bosses
differentiation_axes: heat gauge and overdrive transformation define combat tempo
chapter-boss structure with dedicated finale stages
fire breath spacing and flame-resource decisions beyond plain melee combos
mythic dragon-warrior presentation instead of grounded urban or relic action
hazard-rich stage scripting tied to volcanic and infernal themes
forbidden_template_reuse: no overdrive as a minor stat buff without form shift
no generic side-action reskin with only palette changes

map_content_budget.play_area_model: scripted side-scrolling stages with combat arenas hazards and boss chambers
map_content_budget.interactive_regions: combat lanes vertical jump arcs locked arenas boss chambers hazard pits and reward clear spaces
map_content_budget.decorative_prop_count: at least 12 major stage prop families
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: side-view stage scroll with arena lock pauses and fixed boss framing

special_rules: overdrive transforms the player into a stronger combat state
boss phases escalate patterns at health thresholds
stage hazards reshape spacing during combat
risk_reward_systems: spending heat early reduces overdrive timing potential
maintaining long combos improves score but increases positioning risk
air aggression can bypass hazards but exposes landing recovery

asset_variety_budget.minimum_distinct_sprite_families: at least 2 player forms 6 standard enemy families 3 elite families and 6 bosses
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: delivery-ready output must preserve animated fire-action readability and cannot degrade into static actor placeholders
